releaseTitle: Hotspot Manager v1.9.0 - Critical Safety + Readability Fixes
releaseNotes:
• 🛡️ CRITICAL: Deleting vouchers can NO LONGER kick active users offline (active vouchers are automatically protected/skipped in all delete operations)
• ⚠️ Expired tab now shows ONLY truly expired vouchers (by time or quota as marked by the router) — valid/using vouchers never appear or get deleted
• 📊 Metrics show activated counts only (no more confusing '1/289' style)
• 🎨 FIXED unreadable text: removed dynamic wallpaper coloring, added fixed high-contrast emerald/slate palette + readable cards
• 🔧 Same-signature update — installs directly over v1.6.3 without uninstalling

Installs over v1.6.3/v1.8.0 with NO data loss.
